story.text: Walking out together, Elizabeth thanks Darcy for all he did for Lydia. He answers: “If your {FEELINGS} are still what they were last {APRIL}, tell me so at once.” Hers have {CHANGED}, and she accepts him. Lady Catherine’s visit “taught me to {HOPE},” he says, and he has told Bingley he was {MISTAKEN} about Jane. “By you, I was properly {HUMBLED}.” That night Jane asks how long she has loved him. “It has been coming on so {GRADUALLY}, I hardly know when it began.”
story.caption: All was acknowledged, and half the night spent in conversation
